intro.title: Clay Tunnels
intro.body: The Rustbugs broke through the clay last night, and they want the Core. Dig in, hold the line, and show them whose burrow this is.
intro.line: Burrower crew, engines warm. We dig. We hold.

outro.title: Tunnels Held
outro.body: The clay breach is sealed and the Core still glows. The scrap tracks lead down to the old Iron Works.
outro.line: Good digging, crew. Tighten your bolts, we head deeper next.

intro.title: The Iron Works
intro.body: Below the clay sit the old Iron Works, where the Rustbugs rebuild themselves from scrap. Expect more Gunners and Brutes, and faster waves.
intro.line: Every bug we break here is one less they can bolt back together.

outro.title: Works Shut Down
outro.body: The assembly line is scrap, and the Rustbugs can't rebuild up here anymore. The heat keeps rising from below, so we drill on to the Magma Depths.
outro.line: Iron Works, quiet at last. Next stop: somewhere much hotter.

intro.title: Magma Depths
intro.body: At the bottom of the world, the swarm draws its heat from the magma. Seal the deep breach and the Rustbugs lose their spark.
intro.line: Hot hull, steady hands. Let's go.

outro.title: Breach Sealed
outro.body: The deep breach is sealed and the swarm's fire is going out. The Core glows steady, and for once the tunnels are quiet.
outro.line: Not every tunnel is on our map yet. Whatever is down there, we'll be ready.

end.title: The Burrow Holds
end.body: Thirty stages, three chapters, one Core still glowing. Rumor says more tunnels branch off far below, and the drill is ready.
end.line: The Pit is still open if you miss the noise. See you down there, Burrower.

unlock.title: The Pit Is Open
unlock.body: Under the tunnels lies the Pit, where the swarm never stops coming. Try Siege from the Lobby and see how long you can hold.
unlock.line: No end in sight. Just us, the Core and the swarm.

siege.intro_line: The Pit never runs dry. How long can you hold?

meta.grant_line: Crew crate unpacked: two of each booster. Save them for when the swarm gets thick.
meta.daily_line: Supply drop from the surface. Grab it and get back to digging.
meta.first_defeat: The swarm got through this time. Patch the hull, crew, and we go again.

stage.s01_log: Log 1: First Rustbugs in the clay. Fire straight and keep them off the Core wall.
stage.s02_log: Log 2: One of them carries a long gun. Gunners shoot fast, so stay out of their line.
stage.s03_log: Log 3: Brick chips away a quarter at a time. Cut your own lanes, but leave the Core wall whole.
stage.s04_log: Log 4: Watch for flashing Rustbugs. Hit one and it drops a power-up for us.
stage.s05_log: Log 5: The Scouts keep getting quicker. Hold this tunnel and a new chamber opens below.
stage.s06_log: Log 6: Heavy shell on the scanner. That's a Brute, and it takes four good hits.
stage.s07_log: Log 7: The tunnels shake every night. Something is pushing the swarm up from below.
stage.s08_log: Log 8: Steel plates in the clay now. Grab enough Gun Up and we punch right through.
stage.s09_log: Log 9: They come four at a time. Pick them off one by one and keep the Core behind you.
stage.s10_log: Log 10: The clay breach is right ahead. Close it and these tunnels are ours again.
stage.s11_log: Log 11: Furnaces still warm. Down here the swarm patches itself together from old parts.
stage.s12_log: Log 12: Five on the field at once now. Keep moving, a still drill is an easy target.
stage.s13_log: Log 13: Oil on the floor. Brake early or we slide right into their sights.
stage.s14_log: Log 14: More Gunners on the walkways. Use the steel as cover and fire around corners.
stage.s15_log: Log 15: Saw one Rustbug bolt a new horn onto another. They are building Brutes now.
stage.s16_log: Log 16: Steel everywhere in this hall. A maxed gun turns it into open road.
stage.s17_log: Log 17: The scrap piles are shrinking. Good, fewer parts for them to rebuild with.
stage.s18_log: Log 18: The whole works is grinding at us. Shield up when the Brutes line up.
stage.s19_log: Log 19: The heat comes from under the furnaces. Their real source is deeper still.
stage.s20_log: Log 20: The main assembly line. Break it and they stop coming back for spare parts.
stage.s21_log: Log 21: Lava on the map. We can't drive over it, but our shots fly right across.
stage.s22_log: Log 22: The bugs glow brighter near the magma. Same armor, more fight.
stage.s23_log: Log 23: Six on the field at once. Pick a lane and own it.
stage.s24_log: Log 24: Roots grow over the paths down here. A Rustbug could be hiding under them.
stage.s25_log: Log 25: Halfway down. The heat haze makes everything shimmer, so trust the scanner.
stage.s26_log: Log 26: Five Brutes in this chamber. Keep a Shockwave ready for when the line breaks.
stage.s27_log: Log 27: The hull is warm to the touch. Keep the Core wall patched and hold.
stage.s28_log: Log 28: We can hear the breach now, a long low roar under the rock.
stage.s29_log: Log 29: One chamber left before the breach. Everything we learned, we use now.
stage.s30_log: Log 30: The deep breach. Hold here, seal it, and the swarm goes cold.
